item_name: Rothco Colonial Betsy Ross Flag T-Shirt - Black
item_short_desc: Show your appreciation for American history with Rothco’s Colonial Betsy Ross Flag T-Shirt. This black t-shirt features a bold, distressed red, white, and blue 13-star colonial flag graphic prominently displayed across the chest, adding a vintage feel to a timeless symbol. The reverse side of the shirt also displays a distressed Betsy Ross flag on the right sleeve, giving it a complete patriotic design. Made with a soft, lightweight cotton / polyester fabric blend, this short sleeve shirt is designed for comfort and durability.
